title: Pool Heat Pump Winter Cover 101 × 86 × 78 cm – Ventilated
seo_title: Pool Heat Pump Winter Cover – 101 × 86 × 78 cm
seo_description: Winter cover for a pool heat pump in black 210D fabric, 101 × 86 × 78 cm. A vent opening on the side and eyelets with cord keep the cover in place.
descriptionHtml:
The snow that's already settling on the pool pump

The pool heat pump stays outdoors when the season is over, and snow and rain settle directly on the housing week after week if nothing covers it. A tightly closed lid can also trap moisture inside instead of keeping it out.

A cover that breathes – 101 × 86 × 78 cm

The cover in black 210D fabric covers the pool heat pump in the dimensions 101 × 86 × 78 cm. The vent opening on the side lets air through so moisture doesn't stay inside, and the eyelets with cord along the bottom edge tighten the cover around the base of the pump.

Features

  • Snow and rain are kept off the pump – the 210D fabric cover covers the whole housing, 101 × 86 × 78 cm.
  • Air circulates without moisture staying inside – the vent opening on the side lets air through.
  • Stays put at the base of the pump – eyelets with cord along the bottom edge are tightened around the bottom edge of the cover.
  • Fits pool heat pumps up to 101 × 86 × 78 cm – the cover's dimensions are set to that size.

The lifestyle images are AI-generated illustrations.

The pool heat pump is not included, only the cover.
